extracted.name: Sautéed Broccolini
extracted.description: This easy sautéed broccolini recipe is a perfect weeknight side dish! It's ready in minutes, and it's deliciously seasoned with garlic, red pepper flakes, and lemon.
ingredient_lines: 1 bunch broccolini (trimmed, halved lengthwise if thick (about 6 ounces))
¼ teaspoon sea salt (plus more to taste)
instruction_lines: Heat the olive oil in a large lidded skillet over medium heat. Add the garlic and red pepper flakes and cook for 30 seconds, then add the broccolini and salt and toss.
Cook, tossing occasionally, for 2 minutes. Add the water, cover, reduce the heat, and cook for 3 to 5 minutes, tossing occasionally, or until tender and bright green.
Remove from the heat, toss with the lemon juice, and season to taste.
